checks: All listed expected meanings retained with valid source evidence; governing evidence is substantive and belongs to the rule; both branches and thresholds preserved. No acceptance-count-only quality judgment. Raw review decides gate.
gate: Full audit only if all three treatment inventories satisfy the stated semantic and evidence checks. Otherwise stop and document findings without tuning.
control: Frozen previous audit code, same current source catalog and generation settings. Comparison prompt unchanged. One observation per cell; no stability or independent gold claim.
